description_en: Creates an IM channel for a specified agent and binds a publicly accessible ServiceEndpoint
description_zh: 为指定智能体创建 IM 渠道，并绑定可公开访问的 ServiceEndpoint
name: CreateAgentIMChannel

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to display the thinking process in IM messages. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示思考过程，默认值为 false
fields.name: show_thinking

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to display the tool calling process in IM messages. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示工具调用过程，默认值为 false
fields.name: show_tool_calls

fields.help_en:
The IM channel type. Valid values:

DINGTALK: DingTalk.
FEISHU: Lark.
WECOM: WeCom
fields.help_zh: IM 渠道类型。枚举值：DINGTALK（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECOM（企业微信）
fields.name: channel_type

fields.help_en: The channel credentials. All fields must be provided and field values must be non-empty strings. DingTalk uses clientID and clientSecret. Lark uses appId and appSecret. WeCom uses botId and secret
fields.help_zh: 渠道凭据，必须全量传入且字段值为非空字符串。钉钉使用 clientID 和 clientSecret，飞书使用 appId 和 appSecret，企业微信使用 botId 和 secret
fields.name: credential

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the IM channel. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否启用该 IM 渠道。创建时默认值为 true
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The ID of the ServiceEndpoint to bind. The endpoint must belong to the specified agent and its current version, be in the ready state, and have a public network address
fields.help_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint ID。该端点必须属于指定智能体及其当前版本，并已就绪且具有公网地址
fields.name: service_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: A reserved idempotency token. The backend does not provide persistent idempotency guarantees in the current phase
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等令牌，本期后端不提供持久化幂等保证
parameters.name: client_token
